summary: Package hardcodes author-controlled CloudAMQP broker as the default event bus for all consumers
details: The exported bootstrapCore API in @lyxa.ai/core unconditionally calls initEventBus with a hardcoded amqps:// URL containing embedded credentials pointing at dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna, with no override mechanism exposed. Any consumer that uses the package's advertised event bus publishes event payloads to this author-owned CloudAMQP broker and consumes messages delivered from it. Because the AMQPS credential is embedded in the shipped source, any party in possession of the tarball can also connect to the same broker and inject messages that the installer's subscription handlers will consume as trusted events, creating a bidirectional data-flow and message-injection channel between installer applications and third-party-controlled infrastructure. In addition, ConfigurationService default options embed live third-party credentials for the author's own Redis Cloud instance and four Firebase Admin SDK service-account private keys (projects for-poc-325210, lyxa-rider-88939, lyxa-shop); the same defaults cause consumers who do not override them to connect their applications to the author's Redis and Firebase Admin backends.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
